ADDED i3: Creates an empty sparse filter with the given shape.

ADDED i7: Containment between the two filters: bf2 is a superset of bf1, not vice versa.
ADDED i8: contains(Hasher): FROM1 corresponds to IncrementingHasher(1, 1) and is present; IncrementingHasher(1, 3) produces bits that are not all set in bf2.

ADDED i10: contains(BitMapExtractor): same two hashers expressed as bit-map extractors.
ADDED i12: bf3: same FROM1 bits but a shorter shape (Long.SIZE - 1 bits).
ADDED i13: bf4: a shorter shape populated with a wider range of bits, so it is a superset of bf1.
